lines.text: The crafty serpent tells the woman she will not surely die and will be like God, knowing good and evil.
The woman eats the fruit and gives some to her husband, and they sew palm branches together.
The man and his wife hide among the trees, and the man says the woman gave him fruit.
God tells Adam the ground is cursed, and he will sweat for his bread until he returns to water.
The LORD God banishes the man from Eden and stations cherubim and a flaming sword on the east side.
